17/06/2018


Ms Alison Goody
Occupational Therapist
Northwood Community Health Centre
Northwood


Dear Ms Goody,


Re: Ms Betty Weston
DOB: 12/ 2/ 1964


I am writing to request a wrist splint and ergonomics assessment for Ms Weston, who is
being discharged today from our hospital after the diagnosis of a carpal tunnel syndrome.                                               Commented [May1]: No article required for names of
                                                                                                                                        medical conditions as they are inherently definite, and do not
                                                                                                                                        need to be distinguished. It should be ‘diagnosis of carpal
                                                                                                                                        tunnel syndrome’ without ‘a’.
Regarding Ms Weston ’s medical history and social background, she has diabetes mellitus                                                 Commented [May2]: This clause introduces the entire
                                                                                                                                        paragraph. Since the information in this paragraph is not
type two, hypothyroidism and obesity. She works as a supermarket manager for which she                                                  confined only to medical history, I added ‘social background’
                                                                                                                                        to make it more inclusive.
stands on her feet all day for long hours. Although she is aware that obesity is an
aggravating factor for her tiredness, her diet is high in fat and calories. Please note, she has
a sedentary lifestyle activity.


Initially, Ms Weston presented complaining of numbness and tingling sensation in the
thumb, the index and the middle finger of her right hand over the last past three weeks. Her
                                                                                                                                        Commented [May3]: Using ‘and’ or ‘but’ to link 2 clauses
sleep was disturbed by pain, but her pain was relieved by moving her fingers. She had                                                   (no comma before the conjunction). Read more here:
                                                                                                                                        https://oetonline.net.au/mod/page/view.php?id=534
difficulty in unscrewing jar tops, and gripping a cup and as objects were slipping from her                                             Commented [May4]: Parallel structure:
fingers. She had no trauma to the right hand or pain in the other joints. On examination, her                                           She had difficulty in unscrewing jar tops (parallel)
                                                                                                                                        She had difficulty in gripping a cup (parallel)
right hand grip strength was decreased, and it had no swelling. Phalen’s manoeuvre and                                                  She had difficulty in objects were slipping from her fingers
                                                                                                                                        (not parallel)
Tinel’s sign were both positive, and her BMI was 32 kg/m2.
                                                                                                                                        Read about parallel structures here:
                                                                                                                                        https://oetonline.net.au/mod/page/view.php?id=535
                                                                                                                                        Commented [May5]: Using ‘and’ or ‘but’ to link 2 clauses
                                                                                                                                        (no comma before the conjunction). Read more here:
                                                                                                                                        https://oetonline.net.au/mod/page/view.php?id=534
                                                                                                                                        Commented [May6]: Comma not necessary.

                                                 written permission from OET Online.
 
Website: http://oetonline.net.au


Considering her discharged plan, a night-time wrist splinting for more than three weeks and                                             Commented [May7]: This an attributive noun and not a
                                                                                                                                        verb, so it should be ‘discharge plan’.
reduction in her BMI were recommended. An electromyography and a nerve conduction
study were ordered, and a referral to a psychotherapist physical therapist was done.


In light of the above, your further management of Ms Weston’s condition would be greatly
appreciated. If you require any further clarification, please do not hesitate to get in contact.                                        Commented [May8]: You have taken my previous comment
                                                                                                                                        into account . Good sentence here!


Yours sincerely,
Doctor.

 Comments              purpose is clear and stated early in the letter. There were a few mistakes
                       related to parallel structures, punctuation and article use, so please take
                       note of those. However, overall, the main message has been
                       communicated satisfactorily to the reader.

                       Grade: B (350)
